title: Raising the catalog TTL after the June load test

messages.speaker: Marcus Lee
messages.content: Load test shows a 62 percent hit ratio at a 120 second TTL. Origin database load is still too high.

messages.speaker: Priya Raman
messages.content: The price bug is fixed at the source now, so a longer TTL is safe again.

messages.speaker: Marcus Lee
messages.content: I suggest 600 seconds. Hit ratio in the test climbed to 88 percent.

messages.speaker: Priya Raman
messages.content: Decision: catalog TTL goes from 120 to 600 seconds. See TKT-111.

messages.speaker: Elena Petrova
messages.content: Please update DOC-005 once it ships.
